name: – Ilhan Kyuchyuk – Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the verification of credentials
part_text:
The European Parliament has checked the election results sent in by member states and confirms that the newly elected Members listed in the annex can take their seats. This is subject to any disputes still being looked at in their own countries. Parliament also asks member states to send the names of substitute Members and to finish examining any election disputes quickly.

- The mandates of the listed Members are declared valid, so they can sit in Parliament.
- It affects the newly elected Members whose elections were notified and who made the required declarations.
- Member states must send substitute lists and resolve disputes, then tell Parliament the outcome.
